title: Bound states of Schrödinger-Poisson system in electromagnetic fields
summary: This paper investigates the Schrödinger-Poisson system involving electromagnetic fields. Our approach is mainly based on the variational method. By developing the global compactness result, we establish the existence of higher-energy bound state and ground state solutions under suitable assumptions. In addition, under symmetry conditions, the existence and multiplicity of intertwining solutions are obtained for both finite and infinite symmetry group.
